parts.covers: Counts distinct approved-payment bills per day as a proxy for daily visitors (shopper_count); actual shopper identities and visits without a purchase are not recorded.
parts.sql: select substr("pos-payments-june"."ts",1,10) as "day", count(distinct "pos-payments-june"."bill_id") as "visitors" from "pos-payments-june"  where ("pos-payments-june"."till_status" = ?) and (substr("pos-payments-june"."ts",1,10) between ? and ?) group by substr("pos-payments-june"."ts",1,10) order by "day" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From payment attempt records; keep rows where pos payments.till_status = 'approved' and pos payments.ts between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by day(pos payments.ts); report day = day(pos payments.ts), visitors = count distinct of pos payments.bill_id; sorted by day asc.
